title: 032李铭烨，你这人到底怎么回事？
slug: 年少情深被辜负他跪了我不要了
content_zh:
第(1/3)页

潘乔菲接到电话的时候，正对着一堆亏损报表发愁。

助理说是一位姓李的先生找她，约她下午三点在国贸三楼的茶餐厅见面。

她第一反应是林萧那边出了什么事，第二反应才想起来...

姓李的，除了那位之外，还能是谁？

潘乔菲到的时候，李铭烨已经在包厢里了。

他坐在靠窗的位置，面前放着一杯没动过的茶，手指在桌上不紧不慢地敲着。

听到门响，他抬眼平静地看了过来。

潘乔菲被他这一眼看得后背发毛，脑子里瞬间闪过爷爷的声音。

“乔菲，你要离李家人远一点，尤其是李铭烨！”

“李，李总。”

潘乔菲站在门口，手指勾着包带，进也不是退也不是。

上次在商场被林萧当众逼到道歉之后，她回家又被潘廷旭训了一顿，紧接着就是爷爷的警告。

现在的潘乔菲，对李家这对夫妻都有心理阴影。

“坐。”

潘乔菲坐了下来，把包放在膝盖上，两只手交叠在包面上，尴尬地笑了几声。

“李总，您找我来是有什么事吗？”

李铭烨看着她这副样子，心里冷笑了一声。

就这点胆量，还敢跟他老婆合伙做生意。

“今天找你来，不是什么大事。”李铭烨端起茶杯抿了一口，“就是想问问你，你和林萧合作的事。工厂，生产线，怎么个事？”

潘乔菲的心跳漏了一拍。

想起林萧反复叮嘱过的话：这件事先不要让李铭烨知道，尤其不能让他知道工厂是潘家的。

“什么，什么工厂？”潘乔菲努力让自己的声音听起来不那么抖，“我跟她没什么合作啊，就是上次在商场碰到，聊了几句。李总你是不是搞错了？”

李铭烨放下茶杯，看着她。

十秒后，潘乔菲开始受不了，觉得浑身不自在，她开始躲李铭烨的目光。

看到这儿，李铭烨勾唇一笑。

“潘小姐，你可能不太了解我，我这个人最讨厌别人骗我。尤其是，骗我之前还没做好功课。”

潘乔菲的嘴唇抿成一条线，不敢接话。

“你名下的工厂闲置了一年多，生产线全新，一直在找人接手。林萧最近在帮红颜美妆做营销方案，她需要新的供应链，然后你们就‘偶然’在商场碰到了，还‘偶然’聊了几句。”

“你觉得我会信吗？”

潘乔菲的脸色已经煞白，她知道瞒不下去了，但还是想厚着脸皮赌一把，一口咬定不知道。

李铭烨看着她的表情，知道差不多了。

对付这种人，他比潘廷旭有经验得多。

“老爷子最近身体还好吗？”李铭烨忽然换了个话题问。

潘乔菲浑身一僵。

“我听说潘家最近资金链有点紧，好几个项目都停了。你爷爷上次来找我，希望李家能继续投那个文旅项目，你应该知道这件事吧？”

When Pan Qiaofei received the call, she was worrying about a pile of loss statements.

The assistant said that a gentleman named Li came to her and asked her to meet at a tea restaurant on the third floor of China World Trade Center at three o'clock in the afternoon.

Her first reaction was that something happened to Lin Xiao, but her second reaction was that she remembered...

Who else could the person named Li be besides that one?

When Pan Qiaofei arrived, Li Mingye was already in the box.

He was sitting by the window, with an untouched cup of tea in front of him, tapping his fingers leisurely on the table.

Hearing the knock on the door, he raised his eyes and looked over calmly.

Pan Qiaofei felt the hair on his back when he saw him, and his grandfather's voice flashed in his mind.

"Qiao Fei, you should stay away from the Li family, especially Li Mingye!"

"Li, Mr. Li."

Pan Qiaofei stood at the door, her fingers hooked on the strap of her bag, neither advancing nor retreating.

After being forced to apologize in public by Lin Xiao in the mall last time, she was scolded by Pan Tingxu again when she returned home, followed immediately by her grandfather's warning.

Now Pan Qiaofei has a psychological shadow on the Li family couple.

"Sit."

Pan Qiaofei sat down, put the bag on her knees, folded her hands on the bag, and laughed awkwardly.

"Mr. Li, why did you come to see me?"

Li Mingye looked at her like this and sneered in his heart.

With this little bit of courage, he dared to start a business partnership with his wife.

"It's not a big deal to come to you today." Li Mingye picked up the tea cup and took a sip. "I just want to ask you about your cooperation with Lin Xiao. What about the factory, the production line?"

Pan Qiaofei's heart skipped a beat.

I remembered what Lin Xiao had repeatedly warned: Don’t let Li Mingye know about this in advance, especially don’t let him know that the factory belongs to the Pan family.

"What, what factory?" Pan Qiaofei tried hard to keep her voice from sounding so shaky, "I don't have much cooperation with her. We just met her in the mall last time and chatted for a few words. Mr. Li, are you making a mistake?"

Li Mingye put down his teacup and looked at her.

Ten seconds later, Pan Qiaofei couldn't bear it anymore and felt uncomfortable all over. She began to avoid Li Mingye's eyes.

Seeing this, Li Mingye raised his lips and smiled.

"Ms. Pan, you may not know me very well. I hate people lying to me the most. Especially if I haven't done my homework before lying to me."

Pan Qiaofei pursed her lips into a thin line and did not dare to answer.

"The factory under your name has been idle for more than a year. It has a brand new production line and has been looking for someone to take over. Lin Xiao was recently helping Hongyan Beauty make a marketing plan. She needed a new supply chain, and then you met in the mall by chance and chatted for a while."

"Do you think I will believe it?"

Pan Qiaofei's face turned pale. She knew she couldn't hide it anymore, but she still wanted to take a shameless gamble and insisted that she didn't know.

Li Mingye looked at her expression and knew it was almost done.

He has much more experience in dealing with such people than Pan Tingxu.

"How is the old man's health recently?" Li Mingye suddenly changed the topic and asked.

Pan Qiaofei stiffened.

"I heard that the Pan family's capital chain has been a bit tight recently, and several projects have been stopped. Your grandfather came to see me last time, hoping that the Li family could continue to invest in the cultural tourism project. You should know about this, right?"
